targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: [2026-09-23 | V3-EXQ-1043b | failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-1043b_2026-09-23] mixed, diagnostic, excluded from scoring. Third and best-instrumented run of this lineage (6 seeds, 18.2h, 1000-draw random-subspace reference). ALL readiness gates green including an explicit positive control, non_degenerate true, so neither a precondition-unmet nor a vacuous-pass case. The registered CONFIRMING conjunction is not met: C2-primary's 95% CI on the cross-seed mean is [-0.01547, +0.07370] (includes 0 and 0.05) and C4b passes only 3 of 6 seeds against 4 required. BUT the run DID adjudicate a registered leg: the pre-registered rank co-primary falsifies H2-no-orientation AS A GLOBAL CLAIM (Fisher p=2.19e-4 SET-ALL, 6.86e-5 SET-COMPETENT; Simes 0.0060/0.0050; leave-one-out Fisher 0.0099/0.0038; sets agree; not single-seed driven, though it rests on three seeds), so the fitted communication subspace IS oriented beyond a random subspace of the same rank in at least some encoders. That elimination is GLOBAL-scope only: the per-seed rank percentiles split 3 clearly effect-present against 2 clearly absent, the per-seed measurement SE is 0.0021-0.0030 against a cross-seed sd of 0.0425, so the disagreement is a real encoder-level property; an h_other_event (partition_expansion) and a new leg H4-encoder-contingent-orientation were registered on that basis. interpretation.primary_agreement records the pre-registered DISAGREEMENT label orientation_contrast_not_positive_rank_significant_DISAGREEMENT_split; evidence_direction alone understates the run and the pre-registration said so in advance. The C5 single-subspace premise held (0.6099 vs 0.2164 required), so the question is NOT re-routed to MECH-547/MECH-555. C4b's FAIL carries little weight: on two seeds scoring a bit-identical encoder at an identical parsimonious rank, its verdict FLIPPED between 1043a and 1043b, so the conjunct is not reproducible on a fixed subspace. Claim alignment INTACT -- not a weakening.

The legs share one enlarged run rather than needing three separate ones: the discriminating quantity is the SHAPE of the cross-seed distribution, which the current n=6 cannot resolve. learning_extracted: A pre-registered co-primary can decisively adjudicate a registered leg while the run's headline fields (evidence_direction, interpretation.label, hypothesis_verdict) report nothing, because those are governed by the claim's registered CONFIRMING conjunction -- a different and much higher bar than any single leg's declared null. Three runs of this lineage have landed mixed/undetermined while the hypothesis space actually moved.

A pre-registered criterion can be non-reproducible on a FIXED subspace and still be scored as a conjunct. C4b's verdict flipped on seeds 43 and 44 between 1043a and 1043b -- bit-identical encoders, identical parsimonious rank, deterministic RRR, so the same communication subspace scored twice -- because its 32-of-64 Jacobian state sample is unseeded. Measuring a ceiling in-run (the prior autopsy's required fix, correctly implemented) removed the REACHABILITY problem but left the REPRODUCIBILITY of the statistic being compared to it unmeasured. Seed the probe and record its per-seed bootstrap sd before scoring it again.

Averaging over encoders may be the wrong estimand at this interface: within-encoder cross-stratum subspace agreement is 0.610 against chance 0.066 (~9.2x), while cross-encoder agreement is 0.261 against the same chance (~3.9x). Both exceed chance, but replicate-specific structure is a large fraction of the communication subspace.
Negative result worth keeping: C5 held at 0.610 vs 0.216 required, so the question stays with MECH-537 and is NOT re-routed to MECH-547/MECH-555. Two runs have now cleared this premise.

M2 (the 1043a red-team concern that C4b's effective per-unit bar rises toward 1.0 as F approaches I) was left OWED to a successor autopsy by the pre-registration and is discharged here: F/I is 0.40-0.53 on every seed with anchor headroom 0.47-0.60 and n_seeds_unreachable_anchor 0, so the degenerate regime is real in principle and INERT in this run.

A partial application of a prior autopsy's per_claim_recommendation can silently clear GOV-APPLY-1: stamping live_status.evidence.from satisfies the provenance test and closes the row even when the note replacement and the notes-field correction the same recommendation asked for were never made. MECH-537 has now carried the same 'DO NOT queue an experiment from this entry' contradiction through three runs and two autopsies that each named it as owed.

A newly added hypothesis can be observationally identical to the leg it is meant to rival. H4 as first worded ('orientation is encoder-contingent, so the mean is the wrong estimand') made the same prediction as a random-effects reading of H1 on every quantity the design records -- a leg that cannot be adjudicated at any n. The fix is a declared null on EXCHANGEABILITY plus a named encoder-level covariate, with mechanically circular covariates excluded explicitly: here ws250_comm_parsrank correlates at -0.943 with C2 only because C2 = D_randrank - D_comm and D_randrank is flat across seeds.
